scope: One isolated single-span inner base fairing on the frozen v2 beaker profile; style, material, CAD validity, global wall minimum, and family range remain unknown.

units.derivatives: mm per local parameter; second derivatives mm per local parameter squared

identity_and_limits.radial_wall_semantics: 2.5 mm paired radial control gap through the shoulder; not normal wall thickness. A separate rim transition increases the endpoint gap to 3.5 mm.
identity_and_limits.rim_gap_semantics: local thickened rim endpoint gap from 2.5 mm at shoulder to 3.5 mm at mouth; style and functional suitability unknown

nominal_case.height_semantics: rim_endpoint_z_mm; lip crest is higher and full geometry height/bbox is not validated

curve_definition.basis: piecewise quintic Hermite data converted to exact degree-5 Bezier control nets
curve_definition.inner_side_pairing: side spans before the last shoulder-to-rim span use exact 2.5 mm radial endpoint/control gap; the last span uses a degree-5 C2 endpoint fit from 2.5 mm at shoulder to 3.5 mm at rim; no claim of normal offset
curve_definition.axis_joins: expected revolution-axis singularities; excluded from non-axis C2 and normal-ray checks

thickened_rim_radial_endpoint_gap_mm.motivation: greater than 2.5 mm half-turn feasibility lower limit for a 1.25 mm convex-lip sample design target; this is not a style claim

parameter_bounds_for_this_candidate_only.bound_scope: frozen single beaker candidate; not a reusable family or manufacturing range

inner_base_fairing_parameter_width_mm.motivation: sum of the two parent fairing parameter widths; fixed for this isolated single-span candidate, not optimized

acceptance_constraints.non_axis_meridian_c2: all adjoining position, first derivative, and second derivative errors <= 1e-10 in their respective mm/parameter units
acceptance_constraints.side_and_base_control_polygon: outer radius and z monotonic in each declared segment direction; all paired inner radii > 0
acceptance_constraints.lip_control_polygon: radius non-increasing; all z poles >= 110 mm; one symmetric z crest is expected from the sign pattern
acceptance_constraints.sampled_curvature_design_target: finite 1001-sample minimum radius >= 1.25 mm for outer/inner base fairings, first two lower-body spans, and lip; sample target only, never a whole-span bound
acceptance_constraints.paired_radial_setting: exact 2.5 mm radial control-pole separation before the shoulder-to-rim transition; the paired shoulder-to-rim spans vary from 2.5 mm to 3.5 mm with identical z poles and C2 endpoint jets; lip endpoint radial gap is 3.5 mm. These are radial gaps, not normal thickness.
acceptance_constraints.finite_meridian_normal_probe: at 101 fixed parameter samples per eligible outer base/side span, the inward generator normal ray must have one isolated positive first intersection with inner side/floor; report each finite distance, misses, and ambiguous roots; do not call sample min a global minimum
acceptance_constraints.classifier_unknown_diagnostic: keep classifier tolerance fixed at 1e-7 mm; future boundary-offset probes are diagnostic and may not promote UNKNOWN by tolerance relaxation
acceptance_constraints.lip_convexity: compute exact Bernstein signs for r' z'' - z' r''; state convex/no-inflection only if exact same-sign coefficients establish it
acceptance_constraints.normal_thickness_scope: 101 fixed meridian-generator rays per eligible outer base/side span; preserve unknowns and all raw hits; candidate inner-boundary distance is not native material interval or a global normal-wall minimum
acceptance_constraints.inner_base_exact_convexity: for the single inner base span, report exact rational Bernstein coefficients of r prime z double-prime minus z prime r double-prime; certify same nonzero sign only when exact coefficient signs establish it, with strictly negative radial derivative control coefficients proving regular monotone radius
acceptance_constraints.inner_base_curvature_target: finite 1001-sample minimum curvature radius >= 1.25 mm for the one inner base span; sample target only, never a whole-span bound, and invalid/degenerate samples fail

design_basis.change_scope: replace only the two-span inner base fairing by one degree-5 span, retaining the old root/floor endpoint jets and using total parameter width 0.8; all remaining v2 fields are inherited unchanged
design_basis.nominal_height_mm_semantics: rim endpoint elevation, not full geometry crest
